deck.title: Pride Blobs — squishy, bouncy, unapologetically rainbow

props.title: Pride Blobs — ==squishy, bouncy,== unapologetically ==rainbow==.
props.subtitle: A pocketful of cheerful blob characters in Pride colors that bounce, squish, and react when you play with them.

slides.notes: Open with the toy itself if you can — have it on screen and poke a blob. This deck is short and joyful; match the tone.

props.label: The idea
props.text: Not every project needs a business case. Some exist to ==spread a little delight== — a pocketful of blobs that bounce, squish, and smile back.

slides.notes: Land the thesis quietly: joy is a valid reason to build something. Pause here.

tiles.title: Poke a blob
tiles.body: It squishes under your cursor and springs back with a satisfying jiggle.

tiles.title: It celebrates
tiles.body: Blobs bounce and react when you play — every touch gets a response.

tiles.title: Every blob is its own
tiles.body: Each character carries its own colors and personality. No two squish alike.

slides.notes: Demo beats description: poke one live. The personality point is the hook — people pick a favorite blob.

props.title: Visibility can be ==playful==.
props.body: The blobs carry the rainbow — and Pride flag colorways — into a toy anyone can enjoy in ten seconds. No lecture attached.

slides.notes: This is the heart of the project: pride expressed as play, not a presentation. Let the line breathe.

items.title: Lightweight web tech
items.body: A small site built with plain, modern web standards.

items.title: Springy, physics-feel motion
items.body: Squish and bounce are tuned by hand so every poke feels alive.

items.title: Any modern browser
items.body: Nothing to install, no account, no setup. Open the page and play.

slides.notes: Emphasize the frictionless part: ten seconds from opening the tab to your first squish.

tiles.title: Pride flag colorways
tiles.body: Beyond the rainbow — the blobs wear a whole family of flag palettes.

tiles.title: Springy physics feel
tiles.body: Every poke, jiggle, and bounce is tuned to feel satisfying.

tiles.title: Personalities
tiles.body: Each blob has its own character, colors, and way of reacting.

tiles.title: Nothing to install
tiles.body: Runs in any modern browser, instantly.

tiles.title: Free and open source
tiles.body: Browse the code, fork it, or remix your own blobs.

slides.notes: Skim this one out loud — the tiles are self-explanatory. The open-source tile sets up the closing ask.

props.caption: from opening the page to your first squish — live, playable, and open source today

slides.notes: It's not a pitch — it's shipped. Invite them to open the repo or the toy right now.

props.title: Come squish ==a blob==.
props.subtitle: Pride Blobs is live and open source — poke it, star it, or build your own.

slides.notes: Close warm: thank them, share the link, and leave the toy on screen while questions land.
